result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where a restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is vertically misaligned.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card (image, title, and delivery fee) is vertically shifted downward compared to the adjacent 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol...' cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel to the same top baseline (e.g., using consistent top margins/padding and align-items: flex-start on the row container).
